name: Humbition
identity_check: Confirmed as humbition.com, an early-stage deep tech fund 'built by founders', started by the founders of Indiegogo (Slava Rubin) and Zocdoc (Cyrus Massoumi) per TechCrunch (2018) and the site. Portfolio page lists Chef Robotics, Hone, Allara, Previvor Edge, Redcar, River Markets and others. Not Humba Ventures (a separate pre-seed/seed fund, sister firm of Susa Ventures), not Humble Robotics (autonomous freight startup), not Humble Holdings.
